create.title: Balanced smooth residual signed quarter-packet estimate
create.statement_tex: Fix C_bal=16. For every real X and every literal smooth residual M2 block with 1<=K/L<=C_bal, after the accepted fixed smooth gcd decomposition and all preliminary exact-square, near-square, and large-gcd owners, prove |sum_G G P_G|<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon. The absolute value remains outside the G-sum, and P_G retains both quarter shifts, chi_4, the Vaaler taper, profiles, floors, stars, support crossings, signs, and all real-X endpoint labels. This is the open estimate following the proved balanced reduction, not the reduction itself.
create.next_action: Prove the outside-absolute signed G-aggregate for the actual fixed-comparability smooth symbol. Do not replace it by sum_G G|P_G| and do not import the hard endpoint.

create.title: Unbalanced smooth residual product-phase three-quarter estimate
create.statement_tex: For every real X and every literal smooth residual M2 block with K=XL/D^2, M=LK, and K/L>16, prove T_(L,K)=sum_(h asymp L,k asymp K)chi_4(h)a_(L,K)(h,k)e(sqrt(Xhk))<<_epsilon M^(3/4)X^epsilon. The slanted actual symbol retains the exact Vaaler taper, both quarter shifts and signs, profiles, floors, stars, support entries and exits, and transform boundary terms. By the proved smooth Poisson identity this is exactly sufficient for the corresponding physical block, but that identity does not prove the estimate.
create.next_action: Seek a signed rectangular square-root-product estimate retaining chi_4 and the slanted actual symbol. Balanced gcd packets do not control K/L tending to infinity.

create.title: Physical one-count assembly of all M2 packets
create.statement_tex: Use the exact denominator partition with one unexpanded bottom, one hard profile at d=floor(sqrt X), and otherwise smooth profiles; the exact clipped odd-frequency partition; and owner priority R5-Full, terminal T2S, full second derivative, TTY, then the residual U. Split U physically into the unique hard band, balanced smooth labels 1<=K/L<=16, and unbalanced smooth labels K/L>16. If the top signed cone, the balanced signed quarter-packet estimate, and the unbalanced M^(3/4) product-phase estimate hold uniformly with every literal profile, floor, star, sign, shift, support crossing, and real-X endpoint, then every M2 block is O_epsilon(X^(1/4+epsilon)); the O(log^2 X) one-count assembly proves M9-M2.
create.next_action: Prove the three open analytic parents. The reduction itself needs no further packet bookkeeping.

create.title: A canonical hard-top theorem alone leaves smooth M2 packets
create.statement_tex: The canonical density-discrepancy theorem owns only the residual of the unique physical hard band containing d=floor(sqrt X). It has no implication for a smooth band merely because its exponent tends to 1/2. The residual contains a smooth unbalanced witness (delta,ell)=(1/3,0), with K/L=X^(1/3), and a smooth balanced witness D asymp sqrt(X)/2, L asymp X^(1/8), with K/L asymp 4. Hence the canonical hard theorem alone cannot prove the full M9-M2 assembly in the accepted dependency system.
create.next_action: Do not infer full M2 from the hard cone. Treat the two smooth estimate nodes as independent outside packets.
